microprofile_context: Sequential fresh containers, all 529041 organizations staged from raw input, 160000 persons transformed serially without Elasticsearch. Host/filesystem caches uncontrolled; the original repeat is essential evidence. Digests compare complete emitted person JSON. Both LMDB read modes additionally check 128 raw organization bodies. Training is included in organization_stage_seconds. Only aggregate evidence is saved; dictionaries are temporary.

measurement.execution: Full production organization stage; serial bounded person sample; no Elasticsearch.
limitations: Person sample uses the first N rows in every input file, not a random or exhaustive sample.
Person processing is serial; full ingestion uses multiple workers and asynchronous Elasticsearch writes.
Transform timing includes gzip, JSON decoding, join/encoding and SHA256; there is no HTTP or Elasticsearch.
Organization checks verify bounded raw-source bodies and both LMDB reader modes, not every staged value.
Filesystem and host cache state are uncontrolled; compare repeated runs before selecting defaults.
Cgroup peak memory covers the container lifetime; use a fresh container for each invocation.

full_run_context: Order A/B/A/B, A is preserved pre-optimization image, B is selected codec/writer/reader. Same Elasticsearch container, four shards, unchanged mapping/request durability; first A starts with fresh ES volume, later runs reuse it. Every run starts a new constrained pipeline container, stages raw organizations into a fresh temporary store, and recreates the persons index. No concurrent heavy profiling/validation. Input cache warm from profiles; host cache and ES warmup remain uncontrolled.

tests.environment: Docker with real Zstd and Redis; unchanged pipeline constraints

rejected: 50000-record ISA-L/putmulti transactions left less memory headroom and no clear staging improvement over the repeated original control.
putmulti staging was slower than individual inserts in the Zstd samples.
64 KiB dictionary gave essentially the same level-1 codec sample result as 32 KiB.
Global key/person sorting would add preprocessing; it was not implemented or benchmarked.
selection.read_buffers_note: Avoids a compressed-value copy; standalone throughput improvement was not established by the serial samples.
selection.limitation: Observed local A/B/A/B gains with uncontrolled cache/ES warmup, not a portable guarantee or absolute maximum.
